name: @w6w-apps/marketo
description: Manage Marketo leads, static lists, companies and smart campaigns.

w6w.longDescription:
Marketo Engage is Adobe's marketing automation platform, and this app puts the daily loop of running one — leads, static lists, companies and smart campaigns — behind a workflow, whichever pod your subscription happens to run on.

Lead management is the core of it: get a lead by ID, find leads by any field, create or update a lead by whatever key your instance dedupes on, delete leads, and describe the full field schema (standard and custom) before building a field map. List membership rounds it out with add, remove, list-members and is-member actions against a static list, and company create/update/find mirrors the lead sync shape for the account records leads roll up into.

Smart Campaigns get the two actions a workflow actually needs day to day: request a trigger campaign to push specific leads through its flow, and schedule a batch campaign to run — plus reading a campaign's own metadata by ID or by browsing. Building or editing a campaign's trigger/filter/flow graph itself stays out of scope, the same way this pack keeps Mautic's campaign builder and Gitea's admin surfaces out.

Deleting a lead is here as well, deliberately made harder to trigger by accident than everything else, gated behind an explicit confirmation the same way this pack gates every other irreversible delete.
